title: Sennheiser replaced broken IE300 with IE200 (without telling me until it was shipped)
snippet: # Sennheiser replaced broken IE300 with IE200 (without telling me until it was shipped). I've had my IE300s for a while and the left IEM went out. I went through the warranty process with Sennheiser and I just received an email that they shipped me IE200s to replace my 300s. I was given no options and I haven't even heard from them until they shipped the IE200s out. I just don't understand why I'd pay $300 for the IE300s and receive a downgraded $120 product back instead of being able to get or even pay for a repair. [update]: After some convincing and mentioning other's situation I'm shipping back the IE200s and recieving IE600s. - I just bought the ie 300s before knowing all this am i screwed? - Sorry if this is reptetive but you payed the difference I presume ? - It's like replacing a broken hd800 with hd533. - What's with them not actually repairing the units under warranty then give a worst replacement or say you're not allowed to have a replacement for bad design... why should we even bother to buy your product to own wtf. Fix it if you discontinue a model don't replace with worst that's bs. - The IE600 is my favorite iem I own. After awhile I received a random email and they sent me an internal document that stated that there is this little copper circle thing with teeth on the male mmcx connector. This was causing some many of the issues. On all my sennheiser iems I have popped this part off and it solved all of my disconnect and cutting out issues. My question is is why does Sennheiser still produce that little part that goes on that connector when it is a known issue? - I would definitely get my money back and buy another pair from another brand. Especially with these kind of products the customer service needs to be great. It can sound even better but it’s not fair toward a customer to have no communication whether the product is discontinued or not. It’s not that you bought crappy headphones from wish.

title: PXC 550-II discontinued? : r/sennheiser
snippet: Open menu Open navigationGo to Reddit Home. r/sennheiser A chip A close button. Log InLog in to Reddit. Was looking at Sennheiser's US site to get the manual for my PXC 550-II. A google search with site: modifier revealed but the "All Headphones" page () doesn't have any reference to the 550. The 450BT is still there, and shows up also on the Noise Cancelling page (); the 550 is still in the hero image at the top but not listed as a product. So looks like the 550 are now on their way out (or are just out of stock?), and they are sending folks towards the MOMENTUM 3 Wireless for $250 us, the HD450BT at $130 us, and the in-ear CX Plus TW and Momentum TW 2 for in-ear noise cancellation. In the uk if I Google sennheiser outlet they have some amazing bargains, I grabbed a pair of Pxc 550 ii for £85 last week. I had momentum 3 and xm4 and I think the Pxc are better than both of those. sorry for the late reply but I also noticed the pic 550 I had gone from the uk store but after checking today it has reappeared. I’ve noticed the sennheiser website (at least the uk one) has been going through some kind of transition over the last few months a thenoutlet dissp completely and many products weren’t showing up. Continue this threadContinue this thread. I can find them using Google, but they are not listed on their website anymore (US website), Have they been replaced with the Momentum 3 Wireless maybe?
